responsibility: Provides the SPU target’s RTL predicate definitions that gate operands and operators accepted by recog and SPU machine descriptions. It defines SPU-aware register and nonimmediate tests, valid subreg handling, call operand recognition, constant-vector legality, arithmetic/logical immediate acceptance, comparison forms for branches, and helper predicates for shift/extend operators, so that instruction patterns in spu.md and spu-builtins.md can distinguish legal SPU operands beyond generic GCC predicates.
